title: Petition of Altresco Lynn, Inc. and Altresco Pittsfield, L.P., pursuant to 220 C.M.R. §§ 8.05(6)(g) and 8.07(2), requesting the Department of Public Utilities review the actions of Commonwealth Electric Company and Cambridge Electric Light Company, relative to the completion and execution of power-purchase contracts in accordance with the Department's regulations and Orders concerning the Second Requests for Proposals for Qualifying Facility Generation issued by the Companies.
